shortBio.en: Megadeth co-founder bassist; Peace Sells intro figure and long on/off tenure.
shortBio.zh: Megadeth 联合创始贝斯手；Peace Sells 前奏音型与长期上上下下任期。

body.en: Locks Mustaine’s riffs from the early albums through Rust years and later returns. Exit/return cycles are part of Megadeth personnel lore.
body.zh: 从早期专辑到 Rust 年及后来回归，锁住 Mustaine 的 riff。离开/回归周期是 Megadeth 人事传说的一部分。
